title: fix(objectql)!: register a preserve composition’s residual objectExtensions entry; judge residual jobs at composition
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCxiFE11rsKwyNffJZKYqJs)_

Fixes #35711

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no skill teaches placing `objectExtensions` or `jobs` in a manifest-less input of a `'preserve'` composition; the refusal names both entries and prescribes the fix

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：应用作者把几个包拼成一个产物时，若某个没有包标识的部分给别人的对象加了字段，这些字段现在能正常使用；以前字段直接消失，写入时报字段不存在，启动日志也一句不提。
- 为什么做：拼包产物里不属于任何包的"剩余部分"的对象扩展没有任何环节去登记，属于同一组拼包问题的最后一个漏洞；同时两个没有包标识的部分声明同名定时任务时，拼包不拦、启动时两个都不运行。
- 出错会怎样：拼包时新拦下三种写法（剩余部分里的同名定时任务；剩余部分和持有产物标识的那个包给同一对象各加一段扩展；剩余部分给同一对象加两段扩展，即使别的包也扩展了这个对象），不论选哪种拼包方式，只要产物里带有多个包就会拦；作者会在校验时看到点名两处的报错；已构建的产物照常启动，只多一条错误日志；撤回本次合并即可恢复原状，不涉及数据迁移。
- 要你做什么：无。本次虽然收紧拼包规则，但不在受管范围，座位会在完整回归测试对准最终版本之后自行合入。

## What changes

Measured first, on main `c30ce97cd7`, through the real `os serve` (`packages/cli/bin/run-dev.js serve`, SQLite in memory), on `composeStacks([owner, other, noManifest], { manifest: 'preserve' })`:

- **Residual extension.** The input without a manifest extends `probe_account` with `residual_note`. `GET /api/v1/meta/object/probe_account` listed no `residual_note`; `POST /api/v1/data/probe_account` with it answered `400 INVALID_FIELD`; the boot logged nothing about it. `os build` of the same config exits 0 and carries the entry at the artifact's top level (`1 Extensions`), so a built artifact reaches the same drop. Producers: a composition yields `packages[]` beside a residual under `'preserve'` with an input that has no manifest, and under any strategy (`'preserve'`, `'first'`, `'last'`, an index) once an input is itself a multi-package artifact, whose own top-level collections are then residual; a flat composition of inputs that carry no `packages[]` is one package with no residual.
- **Residual jobs.** Two inputs without a manifest declaring job `probe_nightly`: `composeStacks` accepted them; the boot (with scheduled work on) logged `NOT SCHEDULED` at `error` and armed neither.

The fix, REGISTER rather than refuse, because the residual already has an owner: ADR-0130 D4 registers every residual item under `manifest.id`, and the engine already registers the residual's objects and items there; an extension was the one residual entry no door registered.

- **`packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts`.** The residual rule `unclaimedTopLevel` (the one copy every door reads) now lists a top-level `objectExtensions` entry (type `object_extension`) when it names a target and no package body carries an entry EQUAL to it by value. Not by target: the flattened top level repeats each body's entry and a built artifact loses the references, but each copy still holds what its body's entry holds; an equal entry is also the case where nothing is lost. The metadata door still registers no extension (it never registered a body's either).
- **`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`.** The `manifest` service registers those entries after every body, under the residual's id, through the registry's `extend` verb with the same contribution a body's entry builds: `objectExtensionContribution` (`engine-registration.ts`) is the one reading of an `objectExtensions` entry, and `registerApp` step 2b now builds a body's contribution through it too, so the two cannot drift (it carries `place`, which #36236 added to step 2b on main). Two follow-ons of registering:
  - Under `'preserve'` the residual's id is the last input-with-a-manifest's body too, and the registry keeps one extension of a target per package. A residual entry for a target that body also extends (or two residual entries for one target) keeps only the last one's fields; the boot says so once per target at `error`, like the #35228 arm A1 line for one body.
  - An entry whose field names a picklist no package body declares is not registered and is named at boot (`warn`), the residual objects' own rule (the boot's picklist audit would refuse the field).
- **`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`, the composition door.** The residual door now mirrors that reading: an `objectExtensions` entry is claimed by a body only when a body carries an equal entry; the owner body's entries for a target the residual also extends are judged with the residual's, body first (the boot's registration order), so the #22934 sentence ("only the last of these entries' fields register") is now true at that door. `jobs` is judged there by name (a body's job name claims the slot), where `TOP_LEVEL_COLLECTIONS_NEVER_RESIDUAL` used to drop it (that set is the owner-stamp mirror and is unchanged).
- **The `jobs` row's wording, at every door.** It said only the last entry is kept; the binder schedules none. Now: `The runtime keys jobs by name: the metadata keeps only the last of these entries, and the job scheduler refuses a name two enabled jobs share, so when both are enabled neither runs.` (exact only for two enabled jobs; a disabled one counts no collision). One row, so it stays byte-identical across doors.
- ADR-0087 semantic entry `stack-residual-extension-registered-and-jobs-judged`, changeset `minor` for spec, metadata and objectql.

Newly refused at composition (`STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID`, 422), under every manifest strategy once the result carries `packages[]` (`'preserve'`, and `'first'`/`'last'`/an index with a multi-package input):

1. two residual jobs of one name;
2. a residual extension for an object the body carrying `manifest.id` extends with other fields;
3. two residual extensions of one object, also when another package body extends that object (the claim is by value now; it was by target, so both counted as that body's copies and composed).

Unchanged: one residual extension for an object ANOTHER package extends (both register), a residual entry equal to a body's, every package-claimed extension, one residual job.

Not refused, a known gap left to the binder (stated in `residualEntryPredicate`'s docblock and the migration entry): a residual job that shares its name with a package body's job, with other content, composes as that body's copy, and the boot schedules neither of the two enabled jobs. Read from code, not driven.

## Tests

New pins, named after the card:

- `packages/spec/src/stack-residual-extension-jobs.test.ts` — residual job pair refused (code `STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID`, status 422, exact sentence); the single-stack door says the same row; residual extension sharing the owner body's slot refused, body entry first; residual extension of a target another body extends composes; two residual extensions of a target another body extends refused (shape 3); `'first'` and `'last'` with a nested multi-package input refuse a residual job pair (with a CONTROL that the artifact carries `packages[]`); an equal entry is a copy; CONTROLS: one residual job composes, each body's own job name, two packages each extending one target, the owner body's own pair reported once.
- `packages/metadata/src/unclaimed-top-level-residual-extension.test.ts` — `unclaimedTopLevel` lists the residual entry, composed and as built JSON, never the body's flattened copy; CONTROLS: nothing listed when every extension is a body's, no residual without `packages[]`.
- `packages/objectql/src/manifest-service-residual-object-extension.test.ts` — on a kernel through the `manifest` service: the residual field is served (composed and built JSON); it serves exactly what the same entry serves from a body (parity), and a `place`d entry too (anti-vacuity: the placement changes what is served); CONTROL a package-claimed extension unchanged, nothing logged; the owner-slot pair serves the last fields with one `error` line; a dangling-picklist entry is not registered and is named at `warn`.

## Acceptance notes

- Measure-first, step 2 (producers): `packages[]` beside a residual comes from `'preserve'` with an input that has no manifest, and from any strategy once an input is itself a multi-package artifact (its own top-level collections are residual); `'first'`/`'last'`/an index over inputs that carry no `packages[]` compose one flat package with no residual. `os build` carries the composed top level as is (`1 Extensions`, exit 0). This corrects the first version of this note, which said `'preserve'` only; the composition door's docblock always said every strategy.
- #36236 landed on main with `place` in `registerApp` step 2b's extension literal. Merging main here, the residual builder would have registered a residual entry without its placement; the two are now one call (`objectExtensionContribution`), `place` included, and the parity pin covers a placed entry.
- The residual extension's dangling-picklist judgement reads the stack's own bodies, like the residual objects' rule; a field naming a picklist an already-installed package declares is treated as dangling (not registered, named at boot): conservative, not silent.
- The `jobs` row's sentence changed at every door (it said the last entry is kept; the binder schedules none). The #22934 rows stay one table, byte-identical across doors.
- `defineStack` on a hand-built `packages[]` stack judges its whole top level as one package (`stack.KEY[i]`), unchanged here.

## Open items (follow-up cards)

- #36431: a residual job sharing its name with a package body's job (other content) composes and the boot schedules neither (contract review S2, L1). Whether composition should refuse a job name shared across packages is for the maintainer to rule.
- #36432: a residual picklist named only by a residual extension is still refused as unreferenced at validate, build and boot (L1); `packages/metadata/src/picklist-references.ts` still tells authors a composed stack's top-level `objectExtensions` entry is not registered, which after this PR holds only for an entry naming a picklist no body declares (review N1); `sameAuthoredValue` (metadata) hand-copies the spec's `deepEqualAuthored` and no test holds them equal (review N5).
- Not carried by either card: `logResidualSameTargetExtensions` also reports an owner-body pair for a target the residual does not extend, a second line beside `registerApp`'s (review N2).

## Verification

Clause-② reading (seat 7): the diff refuses at composition three shapes that compose today (listed under What changes), under every manifest strategy once the result carries `packages[]`, so it is a narrowing, declared `no (narrowing)` as the claim's conditional names. The contract review at f4e83b06c2 named the third shape and the reach beyond `'preserve'`, which the first version of this body left out. No governed path is in the diff: the seat lands it with `--land` once the dogfood battery is pinned to the head. Registering the residual extension is the REGISTER judgement stated under What changes.
